name: Data Exfiltration
summary: Suspected or confirmed exfiltration of sensitive data to an external endpoint. Covers cloud-storage upload, DNS tunneling, archive-and-FTP, and SaaS-share abuse.

steps.title: Confirm current data-classification map + DLP coverage
steps.description: Verify the most recent classification map identifies crown-jewel datasets and that DLP egress monitors are healthy on every egress chokepoint.

steps.title: Pre-stage legal hold + breach-notification templates
steps.description: Confirm jurisdiction-specific breach-notification templates (GDPR, CCPA, sector regs) and the legal-hold workflow are ready for a same-day trigger.

steps.title: Triage egress anomaly + identify destination
steps.description: Pivot from the alert into network flow + DNS + proxy logs. Identify external destination (IP, domain, cloud bucket) and confirm volume / rate.

steps.title: Attribute exfiltrated data to a classification tier
steps.description: Sample the egressed payload (where lawful) to attribute it to a classification tier. Distinguish public / internal / confidential / regulated.

steps.title: Block egress destination + revoke share links
steps.description: Sinkhole the destination at DNS + perimeter. Revoke SaaS share links and external-collaborator invites tied to the affected resources.

steps.title: Revoke credentials of the actor identity
steps.description: Disable the user / service principal that initiated the egress; invalidate all sessions and refresh tokens; rotate any keys it held.

steps.title: Remove residual access paths
steps.description: Audit for OAuth grants, app passwords, and forwarding rules created by the actor. Remove and document each one.

steps.title: Notify legal + executive stakeholders
steps.description: Brief legal, the privacy officer, and the executive comms lead with the confirmed scope and data classification. Open the legal-hold workflow.

steps.title: Execute customer / regulator notification
steps.description: If notification thresholds are met, file regulator notice and dispatch customer communications using the pre-staged templates.

steps.title: Tune DLP + egress controls
steps.description: Translate root cause into new DLP rules, egress-policy changes, and detection content. Add a regression case to the BAS catalog.
